transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together today because we have an urgent situation. As you're all aware, a former senior engineer left the company last week and is now working for a direct competitor. We have reason to believe proprietary engineering materials may have been copied before the engineer's departure. Given the urgency, I'm prepared to consider approving an emergency court application, but per our pre-motion review routine, I need to receive a report from each of you — litigation, forensic discovery, client-relations, and insurance counsel — before I can sign off. Let's go around the table. Who would like to start?
